title: correctedLocation
responsibility: Says where an explorer address of an entity belongs at its revision: under the category the entity has there, with its branch, commit, section and tab kept.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.at
inputs.description: The address that was asked for.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.entities
inputs.description: The entities of the shown revision, each with the category its manifest declares there.

outputs.name: correctedLocation
outputs.description: The same address under the category of the entity at this revision; null when it is already there, names no entity or the revision does not hold it.
